preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 50 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list `a` must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 50 inclusive.
The integer `n` (number of elements in `a`) must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of the input list `a` must exactly match the given `n`.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a_i, int) for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list `a` must be integers.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly `n + 1` strings, where `n` is the input size.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s_i) <= 200 for s_i in s)
postconditions.description: Each string `s_i` in the output must have a length between 1 and 200 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s_i) for s_i in s)
postconditions.description: Each string `s_i` must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(s_i == s_j for i, j in [(k, k + 1) for k in range(n)] if a[k] == len(s_i)) or (a[k] < len(s_i) and s_i[:a[k]] == s_j[:a[k]])
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive strings `(s_i, s_{i+1})` in the output, the length of their longest common prefix must exactly match the corresponding `a_i` in the input. Specifically, if `a_i == len(s_i)`, then `s_i` must be a prefix of `s_{i+1}`; otherwise, the first `a_i` characters of `s_i` and `s_{i+1}` must match.
